entries.back_en: "Six centuries ago... Back then..."
"An interminable span of time in the eyes of mortals, but a brief instant for us..."
"This is a strange thing... To meet oneself in this fashion..."
"How much longer canst thou defend thyself against me?"
"In spite of all the problems, all that's wrong, I want to believe in my world!"
"Is that the best thou canst do?"
You feel [04][06]'s despair permeating your thoughts... "Maybe... I don't know..."
You feel [04][06]'s despair permeating your thoughts... "I don't know... You're wrong!"
entries.note: Mesmo typo 'despero'; voz 'voce' ok p/ falante.

entries.back_en: "Yes... I am that which was once [04]"
"But which one is dominant? Was [04]"
"If there's still a little of what was [04]"
"Mortals are sometimes weak and foolish... Sometimes they do wrong... But not all are like that!"
"Those who called me here said much the same as thou."
"But their deeds did not live up to the promise of the flowery speech their tongues professed! They sought to use my power to wage war on their own, to kill enemies!"
entries.note: 'ao resistiram' deveria ser 'não resistiram à'; erro de digitação.

entries.back_en: "Enough. Let this end now."
"You are [04]"
"Now I understand what [04][06] was trying to tell me."
"What he really wanted to say is that this world does not need gods."
"That is why... ... I'm going to banish the gods."
entries.note: 'cast them out'→banir deuses; sentido ok, explicita 'gods'.

entries.back_en: "A futile endeavor."
But we needn't worry about that...
That's a pretty radical solution.
Oh, I decided I'd stick around.
